_about: Catmurai player tuning from the Unity prototype (CatmuraiPlayerController.cs, 2026-09-26). Unity units are metres on a character 0.98 m tall (capsule height 0.98, radius 0.22). 'ue_cm_at_150cm' rescales each distance/speed to a character that is 150 cm tall in Unreal (factor 153.06). Keep the ratio to body height if the Unreal character ends up a different size.

runClipSpeed.note: ground speed the Run clip matches at play rate 1.0; play rate = speed / runClipSpeed, clamped 0.8..4 (stops foot sliding)

fallGravityMultiplier.note: applied while falling AND while rising if the jump button is released early (variable-height short hop)

airControl.note: fraction of move speed reachable in the air

fallAnimDelay.note: walking off a ledge only switches the anim to Air after this long (ignores steps/bumps)

maxAirJumps.note: reset on landing; also allowed after walking off a ledge once past coyote time

airJumpRedirect.note: horizontal velocity lerps this far toward stick direction * moveSpeed at the moment of the air jump

maxAirDashes.note: reset on landing; vertical velocity held at 0 during an air dash

dashExitSpeedFactor.note: leaves the dash at moveSpeed * this

dash.direction: stick/WASD if held, else current facing; character snaps to face it; no dash while slashing
dash.jump_cancel: a jump or double jump during a dash ends it and keeps 1.3 x moveSpeed horizontally

slashMoveFactor.note: move speed multiplier while slashing; no turning while slashing

slashImpactFraction.note: hit check at 35% of the duration (~frame 10 of the 33-frame clip)
